tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap produced MIGRATION-MAPPING.md + TODO markers; agent proceeded straight into file-by-file migration without hand-inventorying the source.
The camera page was migrated as an adaptable feature (not deferred) with a device-unavailable fallback; score trial verified the graceful fallback rendered.

tool_limitations.limitation: Preserves the UWP .csproj at .uwp-source/ but never parses it for native-component ProjectReferences (.vcxproj / C++/CX / C++/WinRT). The dependency on OpenCVBridge.vcxproj was invisible in the bootstrap output; the agent discovered it only by manually browsing the solution and PE-inspecting the built DLL.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Scan the preserved UWP .csproj for <ProjectReference> to a native project and surface a loud warning in the BOOTSTRAP COMPLETE block pointing at a rebuild-or-replace pattern anchor.

failed_apis.api: OpenCVBridge (native C++/CX WinRT component, referenced via ..\shared\OpenCVBridge\OpenCVBridge.vcxproj)
failed_apis.why_tried: The UWP C# app called OpenCVHelper types projected from this native component to do the OpenCV image processing.
failed_apis.root_cause: The component's OpenCVBridge.winmd/.dll is AppContainer-flagged (agent confirmed via PE DllCharacteristics 0x1160 -> IsAppContainer:True) and cannot load in a Full-Trust WinUI 3 desktop process. There is no way to consume the native winmd as-is.
failed_apis.fix: Replaced the native component with the managed OpenCvSharp4 (+ OpenCvSharp4.runtime.win) NuGet packages and re-implemented OpenCVHelper.cs in managed C#.

special_apis.special_handling: A C# UWP app that ProjectReferences a native C++/CX or C++/WinRT WinRT component must rebuild that component for desktop OR replace it with a managed equivalent library and re-implement the projected helper types; the prebuilt AppContainer winmd/dll will not load in a WinUI 3 desktop process.

errors_encountered.error: CS0619: 'Mat.Mat(int,int,MatType,nint,long)' is obsolete: Use Mat.FromPixelData instead (OpenCVHelper.cs, 4 sites)
errors_encountered.root_cause: OpenCvSharp4 version churn — the SoftwareBitmap-buffer-to-Mat constructor the agent first wrote was deprecated in the installed package version.
errors_encountered.fix: Switched to Mat.FromPixelData. Library-version detail, not a UWP->WinUI concern.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'MatExpr' does not contain a definition for 'Rows'/'Cols' (OpenCVHelper.cs, ~5 sites)
errors_encountered.root_cause: OpenCvSharp4 API shape — matrix arithmetic yields a MatExpr that must be materialized to a Mat before querying Rows/Cols.
errors_encountered.fix: Materialized the MatExpr to a Mat. Library-specific; agent resolved without skill guidance.

errors_encountered.error: CS1519: Invalid token '}' in a member declaration (OpenCVHelper.cs line 193)
errors_encountered.root_cause: One-off brace imbalance in a hand-authored file during editing.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent browsed the shared/OpenCVBridge folder, read OpenCVHelper.h, listed the built x64 artifacts, then hand-wrote a PowerShell PE-header parser to read the DLL's DllCharacteristics and prove the AppContainer flag before deciding it could not be reused.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~9 turns of investigation before the rebuild-or-replace decision
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The migration skill has no guidance for the 'C# UWP app depends on a native WinRT component' case, and the bootstrap did not flag the native ProjectReference, so the agent had to derive the whole conclusion from first principles.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Concluded the AppContainer winmd/dll cannot load in desktop and replaced OpenCVBridge with managed OpenCvSharp4, re-implementing OpenCVHelper.cs.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A bootstrap warning that detects native .vcxproj ProjectReferences plus a MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md section documenting the rebuild-or-replace rule (so the agent plans it immediately instead of PE-inspecting DLLs).

missing_tooling.need: Detection of native-component ProjectReferences during bootstrap
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: ~9 turns of manual solution spelunking and PE-header parsing.

env_issues.issue: No camera device on the validation machine.
env_issues.workaround: Skill's Defensive-UI rule already covered this — the migrated page shows a fallback panel; both apps are equally hardware-gated.
